segments.dry: The one reviewer with dry, sensitive skin reports these work wonders and gave her the clearest skin she's had in years, and another reviewer notes the pads did not over-dry her face despite regular use.
segments.sensitive: The one reviewer who describes her skin as dry and sensitive reports these work wonders and gave her the clearest skin she's had in years, with enough texture to scrub without leaving scratches.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the pads are very effective at removing excess oil and leave skin feeling clean, recommending them specifically to others with oily skin.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who states her age, 70, reports the product clears bumps quickly without burning, provided the face is kept clean.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently report the pads clean without over-drying, including one using them while on Accutane who specifically needed to avoid further drying and says the pads accomplish that.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports previously red, inflamed areas of acne became flatter and less noticeable over time, though she credits this to her overall routine rather than the pads alone.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers report mixed experiences with the strength of the formula: some say it doesn't irritate the skin and doesn't burn even after decades of use, while a longtime user warns that most people she has recommended it to report it burns badly and cautions against pushing through that reaction.
concerns.spots: One long-term reviewer reports her husband's dark spots cleared after incorporating the pads into his routine; this is the only detailed report on spots in the reviews supplied.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report reduced breakouts and pimples, including two parents using it for their teenage sons' acne with results within about a week; one reviewer notes she still gets occasional breakouts during stressful periods but says blemishes clear faster than before.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the pads are very effective at removing excess oil and leaving skin feeling clean and refreshed.

aspects.libelle: Can sting eyes; salicylic acid formula is strong
Doesn't dry out skin despite treatment strength

extraits.texte: I will be recommending this to anyone and everyone. I have dry and sensitive skin and these work wonders for me. This is the clearest my skin has been in years and they smell good too. I use one every day and it’s perfect for me. The pads have enough texture that I can scrub my face, but not too much to leave scratches like other ones I’ve tried. Will be reordering in the future!

I’ve been using everyday since 2006. I’ve tried to stop before because I was told it could be harsh on my skin and cause premature wrinkles but then I would break out terribly. My husband has worked this into his routine and his acne and dark spots have cleared. This is my secret weapon in a WHOLE skincare regimen and I’ve recommended to everyone that asks what my skin routine is. Cleanser, Oxy pad, toner, eye cream, serum, moisturizer (Google double cleansing and face flooding). Although, everyone that has ever tried this after my recommendation has told me it burns really bad. The salicylic acid is strong. Please be mindful using this around your eyes. If it is too strong, I don’t recommend pushing through and continue using. It could be damaging and cause really bad irritation. I love it but my skin is use to it.

These are my absolute fav!! I make sure to never run out because they don’t have them in the stores by me! I use these daily right after washing my face. It leaves my face feeling so clean and not dried out. I have oily skin and it’s very effective in removing excess oil from my face! Highly recommend this to anyone with oily skin!

I’ve been using these pads as part of my acne routine, and so far I’ve had a positive experience with them. The pads feel nice on my skin and leave me feeling like my face is actually getting cleaned. Since using them, I’ve noticed an improvement in both my facial and body acne. Areas that were previously red and inflamed have become flatter and less noticeable over time. That said, I’m also using a face/body wash and the occasional spot treatment, so I can’t say these pads are solely responsible for the improvement. However, they’ve been a consistent part of my routine and seem to be helping. I still get the occasional breakout, especially during stressful periods, but the blemishes don’t seem to stick around as long as they used to. Overall, these have worked well for me and I’ll continue using them.
I use in the mornings only instead of washing my face. Currently on accutane and have to be careful to not dry out my face. And it does just that! Also, you can buy this with HSA/FSA card!

extraits.titre: Already seeing results after a week!
extraits.texte: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Bought this for my teen son, who’s been dealing with forehead acne..thanks to his stylish lama cut hair constantly sitting on his skin. After just a week of using it, we’re already seeing it clear up! The formula is definitely strong though.. it has a potent smell and can make your eyes sting a bit even if you avoid the eye area. But honestly, that’s just the power of the ingredients doing their thing! Totally worth it. If you're dealing with stubborn acne, especially from hair or sweat, I’d absolutely recommend giving this a try.

As you can see, the two pads on the right side are covered with dirt and oil from my face, showered in the morning and got these in the mail by 2pm later that day, I used two pads and this is the result. The pads are not overwhelming in scent as in the past they used higher levels of Alcohol, the liquid doesn't irritate the skin, all in all OXY is still up to par with quality and price.
